title: Quantifiers and Temporal Ontology
version: Author-hosted copy labelled Mind 115 (2006): 75-97; internal pagination 1-24
locators: Author PDF pp18-21, note 28 and Section 7
assumptions: Discusses conservative presentist tense languages, proposed translations and genuine quantification.
conclusion: Selected footnotes distinguish logical mimicry from the metaphysical interpretation of quantification.
proof_status: Selected arguments and footnotes read directly; not a complete paper audit.
dependencies: Intended meaning and inferential role of quantifiers
open_questions: Does the project provide the claimed translation with the required inferential and interpretive properties?
relevance: Checks the scope of Claude's appeal to notes 5,17,28.
limits: No collapse theorem for indexed E_b inferred; no entire tense-logic or historical-priority audit.

title: The Triviality of Presentism
version: 27 September 2012 draft; 16 PDF pages; not the printed chapter
assumptions: Author's tensed/untensed quantifier regimentation and proposed readings of presentism.
conclusion: Meyer argues that the considered readings fail to yield a nontrivial true presentism.
proof_status: Selected full-text arguments read; conclusion is the author's defended position, not accepted consensus.
dependencies: Interpretation of existence and quantified tense logic
open_questions: How do stronger replies affect the project's particular E_b comparison?
relevance: Confirms the provenance of the regimentation used by Claude.
limits: Not cover-to-cover; no complete version comparison or proof/ontology certification.

title: The triviality argument against presentism
version: Author-hosted online publisher-layout copy, copyright 2017; DOI 10.1007/s11229-017-1601-y; 20 PDF pages
locators: Section 2, PDF pp3-10, especially (8)-(9) and the semantic-metalanguage discussion
assumptions: Examines the standard definition of presentism while separating logical quantification, tense and the interpretation of presentness.
conclusion: Author disputes the triviality argument; the selected quantifier discussion rejects its exhaustive tense-based readings.
proof_status: Framing and selected Section 2 arguments directly read; whole-paper defence not audited.
dependencies: Interpretation of predicate logic and temporal discourse
open_questions: Which rival-language inference survives a full comparison with the project's actual contracts?
relevance: Accessible direct reply to the relevant triviality argument.
limits: Not evidence for a temporal ontology; no independent linguistic verification, complete reply survey or priority claim.
